name: Water
notes: Standing water: puddles, troughs, pools, streams. Saturated (wetness 1), freezes at 0 °C and conducts charge (valley water is never pure). Density exactly 1000 kg/m³, the float threshold. See-through. A deep pool absorbs most of a fall (0.6); shallow water splashes loudly (+6 dB, audio bible §7.3: water-shallow is loud). A liquid (a pool's top is a waterSurface that cold freezes into walkable ice); soft surface. (mw-e03.31)
